sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the Arena, see Arena Events.

Events in Escape from Tarkov are limited time activities that give players new challenges, adjust gameplay & mechanics, and introduce new items that are being tested by the developers for a limited time. Some events are "lore-oriented" which give an insight or backstory to the Tarkov/Norvinsk region, while other events are seasonal holiday events that are done just for fun.
This is not a complete list, and there are many events missing.

sections.heading: Permanent Boss Presence (29 July 2026)
sections.text:
"Something big is clearly brewing in Tarkov, and the situation around the region has become increasingly unstable.
Scav Bosses armed themselves heavily and are now firmly entrenched in their territories. To prevent further escalation, trophies looted from them have been banned from the Flea Market. At the same time, rumors suggest that now might be the right time to start stockpiling that kind of gear.
On top of that, they say that night raids have become quite a lot riskier…"
Gameplay Changes
- All Bosses, except for Cultists and Partisan, have a 100% spawn chance.
- Unique weapons and gear from Bosses cannot be sold on the flea market.
- Scavs and Bosses carry special weapon loadouts featuring high-capacity drum magazines.
- New barters for Dogtags and unique weapons and gear from Bosses.
- Glukhar carries a Magnum Research Desert Eagle L6 .50 AE pistol (WTS) loaded with .50 AE FMJ Bull.

sections.heading: Blackout (14 July 2026)
sections.text:
"Skier has discovered a vulnerability in the Lab’s security system and plans to strip the facility clean. Information this valuable was never going to stay secret for long, and now all kinds of interested parties are converging on the underground complex - each with their own motives. However, someone else was already one step ahead: a team of unidentified operatives in black had infiltrated the Lab. What they're searching for remains unknown, but their presence poses a serious threat."
Gameplay Changes
- The Lab has plunged into darkness and all lights are turned off.
  - The Wedge and Black Division spawn on The Lab.
    - The Wedge carries Admin's key in his pockets, his followers and Black Division have a chance to also carry it.
  - The Parking Gate and Hangar Gate extractions are the only extractions available in every raid, but first require an activation in the system admin's office.
  - The transit out of The Lab is not available, the transits into the map are.
  - The raid time has been increased to 35 minutes in the PvE game mode.
  - All keypad locks can be activated with a 4-digit code found within the system admin's office. The code changes in every raid.
- Colored Lab keycards cannot be taken into a raid, except for the TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black).
- TerraGroup Labs access keycard is available for purchase on Therapist LL2, LL3 and LL4, Ref LL3, and as a barter on Mechanic LL1 for 1× Weapon parts and at LL2 for 1× Bulbex cable cutter + 1× Pipe grip wrench.
- Quest Wrench and Waterboarding has been added.
- Quest Key to Every Door has been added.
- Quest My Blood Type Mark is on the Sleeve has been added.
- Quest Patch the Vulnerability has been added.
- Quest If I Can't Have It has been added.

Rumor has it that the rebels are hauling their loot into the nature reserve, where a ton of valuables can now be found."

sections.heading: Frostbite
sections.text:
effect has been added. The effect occurs by being exposed to snow.

sections.heading: Halloween 2024 (31 October 2024)
sections.text:
Gameplay Changes
- An unknown disease has spread from The Lab and contaminated the whole Tarkov region.
  - The level to which each map is infected can be tracked on escapefromtarkov.com/halloween.
- Infected civilians, lab technicians and PMCs are roaming around, attacking with their hands, knives and pistols.
  - Tagilla is also infected and roams all maps, carrying a scythe.
- Getting too close to them and getting hit grants the Virus effect, which removes hearing for a brief moment and reduces hydration.
  - The effect is only removed upon extraction or death.

- For the duration of the event, Scavs and Bosses are friendly towards players, unless provoked (including maps free from the infection).
- Entry to The Lab doesn't require a TerraGroup Labs access keycard for the duration of the event.
- New area added to the The Lab called "containment block", near the laboratory quarantine zone (G11).

- Player Scavs can get on friendly terms with the infected through drinking 2 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka or 2 Bottles of Dan Jackiel whiskey or 2 Bottles of Fierce Hatchling moonshine.

sections.heading: Halloween 2023 Part 2 (30 October 2023)
sections.text:
- Cultist ritual on all maps besides Factory and The Lab.
  - Finding and killing the roaming Zryachiy will close all extractions but 1 with an increased extraction timer, turn the time to night and start a ritual that is performed by 6 Ritualnyy (Ritual) Cultist priests. The ritual takes 6 minutes and 30 seconds to complete.
    - The place of the ritual is marked by a ritual circle and a blue light beam going into the sky. There are multiple possible locations.

- Klling all Ritual Cultist priests will stop the ritual
- Upon completion of the ritual, Mstyaschiy (Vengeful) Zryachiy appears with massively increased health and starts to hunt down players.

  - "Primal fear" and "Chilling horror" status effects will be applied to players until the end of the raid, causing permanent misfires on weapons and reduced stamina.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Zryachiy drops Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka and Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine when approached by players
- Killing Zryachiy or Vengeful Zryachiy will not decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have one
- The PPSh-41 submachine gun, the MTs-255-12 shotgun, revolvers, stationary weapons, underbarrel grenade launchers and fragmentation grenades can be used to kill Vengeful Zryachiy as they cannot jam.
